title: Taste and See That the Lord Is Good

questions.question: I will bless the Lord at all times; his praise shall continually be in my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 34:1 (ESV): "I will bless the Lord at all times; his praise shall continually be in my mouth."

questions.question: My soul makes its boast in the Lord; let the humble hear and be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 34:2 (ESV): "My soul makes its boast in the Lord; let the humble hear and be glad."

questions.question: Oh, magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt his name how?
questions.explanation: Psalm 34:3 (ESV): "Oh, magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt his name together!"

questions.question: I sought the Lord, and he answered me and delivered me from all my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 34:4 (ESV): "I sought the Lord, and he answered me and delivered me from all my fears."

questions.question: Those who look to him are radiant, and their faces shall never be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 34:5 (ESV): "Those who look to him are radiant, and their faces shall never be ashamed."

questions.question: This poor man cried, and the Lord heard him and saved him out of all his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 34:6 (ESV): "...and saved him out of all his troubles."

questions.question: The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear him, and does what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 34:7 (ESV): "The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them."

questions.question: Oh, taste and see that the Lord is good! Blessed is the man who takes what in him?
questions.explanation: Psalm 34:8 (ESV): "Oh, taste and see that the Lord is good! Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him!"

questions.question: Oh, fear the Lord, you his saints, for those who fear him have no what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 34:9 (ESV): "Oh, fear the Lord, you his saints, for those who fear him have no lack!"

questions.question: The young lions suffer want and hunger; but those who seek the Lord lack no what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 34:10 (ESV): "...but those who seek the Lord lack no good thing."

questions.question: Come, O children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 34:11 (ESV): "Come, O children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the Lord."

questions.question: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 34:13 (ESV): "Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit."

questions.question: The eyes of the Lord are toward the righteous and his ears toward their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 34:15 (ESV): "The eyes of the Lord are toward the righteous and his ears toward their cry."

questions.question: The Lord is near to the brokenhearted and saves the crushed in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 34:18 (ESV): "The Lord is near to the brokenhearted and saves the crushed in spirit."

questions.question: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the Lord delivers him out of them what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 34:19 (ESV): "Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the Lord delivers him out of them all."

key_verse_text: Oh, taste and see that the Lord is good! Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him!
